scripts.gen:api: npm run spec && openapi-typescript openapi/openapi.yaml -o frontend/src/api/schema.d.ts
scripts.api:install: python3.11 -m venv backend/.venv && backend/.venv/bin/pip install -q -r backend/requirements.txt
scripts.mock: npm run spec && node mock/build-mock.mjs && prism mock mock/openapi.mock.yaml -p 3000 --cors
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm:api" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.dev:mock: concurrently -n mock,web -c magenta,cyan "npm:mock" "npm --prefix frontend run dev -- --mode mock"
scripts.build: npm run spec && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm run api:install
